title: Anyaụfụ nke ripịara
intro: Akụkọ ochie karịa alaeze ma ọ bụ akwụkwọ nsọ ọ bụla—ọdachi mbụ mmadụ nke sitere n'ekworo. Otu mkpụrụ obi, nke okenye n'ime ụmụ abụọ nne na nna mbụ mụrụ, ji iwe lere nwanne ya nke nta anya ka a na-anabata ihu ọma nke a jụrụ. Ihe sochiri ya bụ nhọrọ kachasị njọ, nke hapụrụ ọbara mbụ a wụfuru n'ụwa. Ị̀ pụrụ ịchọpụta njirimara ya, ọnwụnwa ahụ, na mwute dị ilu?
clues: A mụrụ m site n'ụmụ mmadụ mbụ bi n'ụwa.
E nwere mgbe m mere onyinye nye Allah, mana ọ bụghị m nabatara ya.
A nabatara onyinye nwanne m nwoke nyere, ebe a jụrụ nke m—ihe m na-enweghị ike idi.
Etinyere m nwanne m nwoke egwu na a ga-ebibi ya.
Abụrụ m onye mbụ gburu mmadụ n'ụwa a, gbuo nwanne m nwoke.
Allah zitere otu anụ ọhịa nke ụwa—nnụnụ ojii na-egwu ala—ka ọ kụziere m otu esi ezo ihe m mere, ihe fọdụrụ m bụ mwute.

arabic: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)
